title: refactor(core): serve the unreact and personal-view doors from one own-row delete door
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ873kbFcJFx4LxoFFBNwCohp)_
Fixes #29636

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:撤销表情(`DELETE /api/v1/comments/reactions/:id`)和删除个人视图(`DELETE /api/v1/personal-views/:id`)这两扇"只删自己那一行"的门,原本是两份几乎逐行相同的复制;现在共用 `@objectstack/core` 里的一扇门,两个插件各自只提供对象名、所有者列、路由和回答用词。另附三处注释/测试:系统身份跳过也放行提权的应用自动化、`manifest.ts` 的过时注释、偏好"替别人建"的 REST 对照测试。
- 为什么改:这段安全顺序(以调用者身份读行→404,核对所有者→403,再以系统身份删除并记到调用者名下)只要两份就会改一处漏一处;合一后只有一个地方要审。
- 风险与回滚:纯搬移,任何一扇门的回答都不变(下面有 17 种请求的前后逐字节对比)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/core/src/security/own-row-delete-routes.ts`(`removeOwnRow` 的第 5、6 步与系统删除的上下文),然后 `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/comment-reaction-routes.ts` 与 `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/personal-view-routes.ts` 的门描述。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run src/comment-reaction-routes.test.ts`,预期全绿,其中 "its verdict on the row" 一组钉住 404 / 403 / 200 + 归属。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**One own-row delete door, in `@objectstack/core`.** `packages/core/src/security/own-row-delete-routes.ts` holds the sequence both doors ran, moved without change: resolve the caller through `resolveRequestExecutionContext`, refuse anonymous, a held sign-in and any query parameter, read the row as the caller (`404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` when it cannot be read), check its owner column (`403 PERMISSION_DENIED` when it names someone else), then remove it under `{ isSystem: true, attributedUserId: caller, tenantId: caller's }` and answer `200 { id, deleted: true }` (a removal that matched nothing is `404`). It exports `registerOwnRowDeleteRoute(http, door, deps)`, `removeOwnRow(engine, door, id, context)` and `ownRowDeleteCallerResolver(sources)`, with the types `OwnRowDeleteDoor`, `OwnRowDeleteWords`, `OwnRowDeleteEngine`, `OwnRowDeleteRoutesDeps` and `OwnRowDeleteCallerSources`.

**Each object supplies its part.** An `OwnRowDeleteDoor` names the route, the object, the owner column and the words its answers use:

| door | route | object | owner column | words (noun / short / owner) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| unreact (`plugin-audit`) | `/api/v1/comments/reactions/:id` | `sys_comment_reaction` | `created_by` | reaction / reaction / member |
| personal view (`plugin-auth`) | `/api/v1/personal-views/:id` | `sys_personal_view` | `user_id` | personal view / view / user |

The words rebuild each door's existing sentences exactly, so no refusal text moves. Each plugin keeps its route file, every name it exported (`registerCommentReactionRoutes`, `platformCallerResolver`, `removeOwnCommentReaction`, `CommentReactionEngine`, …, and the personal-view twins, now thin delegations), its route ledger and its conformance test; neither mount site (`audit-plugin.ts`, `auth-plugin.ts`) changes.

**Why core.** Both plugins already depend on `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/types`, `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/platform-objects`, so no new dependency edge is possible elsewhere. Core is the one that already holds every piece the door composes (`resolveRequestExecutionContext`, the anonymous floor, `evaluateAuthGate`, the API-key and authz-store refusals, `recordNotFoundError`) and already depends on `@objectstack/types` for the envelope writers. `@objectstack/types` could not host it without depending on core (a cycle); spec holds no runtime logic; platform-objects holds object definitions.

**Ledgers that follow the move.**

- `scripts/check-single-authz-resolver.mjs` `DELEGATORS`: the core door's row (`resolveRequestExecutionContext`) is added, and the two plugin rows now delegate through `ownRowDeleteCallerResolver`; the comment above the map says so.
- `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` `MODULES`: the core door is declared at `0 / 0 / 0` (every body through `sendOk` / `sendError` / `sendServerFault`), and the two plugin rows stay at zero with their comments updated.
- Tenant-audit census regenerated (`node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write`): the census reads only `packages/plugins` and `packages/services`, so the two elevated deletes, now one call in core, leave it (256 → 254 sites, 146 → 144 decidably elevated). The six hand-written figures on `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx` follow (57% unchanged).

**Comment items carried on the card.**

- (a) Census row 26c (`content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`) and the `owner-fixed-rule.ts`, `personal-view-hooks.ts` and `user-preference-hooks.ts` docblocks now say the `isSystem` skip also admits app-authored automation elevated to system (a `runAs: 'system'` flow, a hook's `runAs: 'system'` api or `ctx.api.sudo()`, an action body's `ctx.api`), the family `flow-system-identity-write-refusal.ts` names; the rule reads no app-automation elevation mark.
- (b) `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/manifest.ts`: the stale "default flag" comment on `SysPersonalView` is replaced (the default view is the reader's per-object pin), and `SysUserPreference` gets a comment naming its owner rule.
- (c) The `user-preference-hooks.ts` create parenthesis is **kept and pinned**: `[member-create]` in `packages/qa/dogfood/test/user-preference-owner-fixed.dogfood.test.ts`, a member creating a preference in another member's name over REST answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` and stores nothing. The docblock names the pin.

`.changeset/29636-own-row-delete-door.md`: `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/plugin-audit`, `@objectstack/plugin-auth` patch, both declaration lines.

## Why

The card (should-fix S3 of contract review 6586971553, plus the comment items of record 6590198210 and S1–S3 of review 6593114814): a security-relevant sequence lived in two hand-copied files, so a fix to one, such as the 404/403 order or the attribution, would silently miss the other. Triage 6591885150 ruled it move-only: no door may answer differently afterwards.

## Tests

**Measured first, on main's code.** Commit `c5ec5fbc` adds, before any move, a top-level `describe` to each door's existing shell test (`comment-reaction-routes.test.ts`, `personal-view-routes.test.ts`): a row the caller cannot read answers `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` with the read asked as the caller and nothing removed; a row owned by someone else answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` and nothing is removed; the owner's row answers `200 { id, deleted: true }`, removed under `{ isSystem: true, attributedUserId, tenantId }` (none without an organization); a row gone between read and removal answers `404`. The personal-view file also pins that the owner is judged on `user_id`, not `created_by`. On `c5ec5fbc`: plugin-audit 2 files 15/15, plugin-auth 3 files 43/43 (VERDICT command-exit 0).

**The same pins after the move**, on `3f6d5b6a` with core rebuilt: plugin-audit 15/15, plugin-auth 43/43 (`personal-view-hooks.test.ts`'s engine-level door pins included), VERDICT command-exit 0.

**Byte-for-byte answer comparison (one-time, not committed).** A scratch test drove each door's registered handler through 17 requests (authz store outage, resolver fault, two anonymous shapes, held sign-in, query parameter, blank and missing id, no engine, engine fault, unreadable, foreign, own with and without an organization, vanished as `0` and `false`, a `409` from the delete) and recorded status, full body, and the engine's `findOne` / `delete` arguments. Before (`c5ec5fbc`) and after (`3f6d5b6a`) are identical: unreact sha256 `350545f0…b628a6`, personal view `e7322879…65a435`, `cmp` clean for both.

**Through the real stack, at the head:** `personal-view-row-scope.dogfood.test.ts` and `user-preference-owner-fixed.dogfood.test.ts` 2 files 24/24 (the new `[member-create]` included); plugin-security `comment-reaction-unreact-door.integration.test.ts` 8/8.

**Package suites, at the head:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test` 68 files 1114/1114; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test` 216 files 3708 passed, 10 skipped; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test` 132 files 2934/2934 (VERDICT command-exit 0). `pnpm typecheck` for core, plugin-audit and plugin-auth: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- The tenant-audit census no longer lists the two elevated deletes, because `SURFACE_ROOTS` does not read `packages/core`. Nothing about the write changed (same object, same elevated, tenant-carrying context); widening the census to core is the census's own question.
- `removeOwnRow` throws `removeOwnRow(OBJECT): the caller context names no user` where each copy named its own function. That error is unreachable through the door (step 2 refuses first) and reaches only the fault log of a direct caller.
- The plugin route files keep their exported names as thin delegations so no import site, test or mount moves; a later card can retire them if nobody outside the package needs them.

## Verification

Head `c15745df`. Every gate reading below was taken on `0cfd9309` or later; the derived family set re-derived on `c15745df` is identical (116 families), and the families reading the files changed after `0cfd9309` (the census page, row 26c) were re-run on `c15745df`.

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

- Prerequisite builds under the lock: the plugin-audit and plugin-auth closures, the dogfood and plugin-security closures (VERDICT command-exit 0, 7m19s), the client-react closure for `check:skill-examples` (VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 116 families (17 paths vs merge base `0822122fd`, +627/-529, under the 3000 human-merge threshold). Each run once with its exit captured before any pipe: 115 exit 0.
- One real finding on the first pass, fixed: `check:system-context-census` exit 1, `[unresolved-path]` on row 26c's bare `flow-system-identity-write-refusal.ts`; the row now cites the full path (`c15745df`), and the gate exits 0.
- Two prerequisite refusals on the first pass, re-run after the prerequisite: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (exit 3 until its pinned fixture commit was fetched, then 0, 48 cases); `check:skill-examples` (exit 3 until the client SDK was built, then 0, 283 examples).
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (most workspace packages unbuilt in this container). NOT MEASURED locally; CI runs it on a full build.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 116 derived, 115 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (dual-build, from its recorded exit 3), 0 UNRUN.
- `pnpm lint` (repo-wide eslint): exit 0.
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed (the move is pinned as unchanged, and the one new pin, `[member-create]`, is a control on behaviour that already existed).

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
